title: Amber Hanging Display
desc: Warm amber florals suspended against cool blue tones.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The warm orange bloom trails running down the silver arc.

Yellow-orange multi-head mums adding the larger daisy faces along the trails (multi-head form matched).

groups.label: Fill & volumes
groups.blurb: The cotton-ball whites and fiery fibrous fill.
